root_identity: general-purpose evidence, data, information and public-intelligence acquisition center
architecture_rule: All domain branches are additive subdomains. No branch may rename, replace, narrow or become the Intelligence Center root service.

branches.scope: NASA Earth observation, space science, remote sensing and public mission data
clinical evidence, biomedical data, hospital research, medical datasets, medication, imaging/pathology/genomics sources and medical-tool discovery
financial markets, securities, macro, company filings and investment research
law, regulation, policy and public administration
maps, population, mobility proxies, remote sensing and location intelligence
think tanks, universities, strategy research, declassified archives, consulting and institutional research
industry, trade, energy, transport, manufacturing, agriculture, technology, healthcare and other sector intelligence

branches.label_zh: 知识图谱、知识库、档案库
branches.scope: federated global knowledge graphs, scholarly and research metadata, libraries, archives, museums, cultural heritage, government data catalogs and public knowledge systems across countries, regions and industries

invariants: src/index.js remains the generic intelligence-worker entry point
domain registries may add sources and routing metadata but may not redefine center identity
downstream compute or expert tools remain generic center capabilities and are referenced by branches rather than turning those centers into domain-specific centers
